text:
Priya Patel: Quick help — AtlasHealth POC wants to convert to dedicated with an 18‑mo commit. They're asking for a 25% recurring rebate + $75k migration credit to match competitor. Can we do this? Need reply by EOD PST.

Lena Zhou: What's the committed run‑rate and expected monthly usage? Need margin floor and legal ok for migration credit.

Priya Patel: Commits are $250k/year (billed monthly, committed) so 18‑mo = $375k total. Expected growth first 6mo ~20%. Procurement needs decision by Fri COB.

Marco Ruiz: Quick finance check — if we give 25% + $75k credit net_first_year = 375000 - (0.25*375000) - 75000 = 206250. Need SKU breakdown (dedicated + support) and gross margin impact before final.

PricingBot: ```prelim_calc:
commit_total = 375000
recurring_rebate = commit_total * 0.25
one_time_credit = 75000
net_first_year = commit_total - recurring_rebate - one_time_credit
# net_first_year = 206250```

Samir Nguyen: 25% feels high. For enterprise we can be flexible but prefer a structured offer: 18‑mo commit -> 20% recurring + $50k migration credit + up to $25k milestone credit (paid on adoption targets). Cap total concessions at 30% of first‑year ARR.

Ari Chen: Customer can sign tighter SLA and agrees to 90‑day adoption milestones. Procurement wants milestones in SOW. They'll push for all credits up front.

Lena Zhou: Approve conditionally: 20% recurring rebate, $50k one‑time migration credit, up to $25k milestone credits tied to defined adoption metrics, legal to review SOW and clawback language. Escalate to Samir for anything >20% or >$75k total.

Marco Ruiz: Finance signoff given those caps and clawback. Please include invoice schedule and a 30d usage threshold for clawback. Looping legal for contract language.

Priya Patel: Thanks — I'll send the proposed term sheet and SOW with milestones to procurement now and flag legal. If they push hard, I'll ping @Samir Nguyen for a quick call.

Samir Nguyen: :thumbsup: Good compromise. Don't exceed the caps without explicit signoff. If they insist on 25% we can consider a short promotional bump tied to reference/expedite onboarding.
